priority.summary: Toby R. Neugebauer, the co-founder and largest shareholder of Fermi Inc., has issued a statement in response to the company's decision to drop its lawsuit against him, which was filed to validate a 70% supermajority bylaw amendment. The lawsuit's dismissal comes after a Texas Business Court ordered Fermi to produce documents and testimony explaining the rationale for the bylaw amendment, and Neugebauer claims that the company's actions confirm that the bylaw move was about entrenching the board's power rather than good governance. Neugebauer's claims challenging the validity of the bylaw remain alive and he will continue to pursue discovery and depositions of key players.

general.summary: South Korean police shared with prosecutors the findings of a long-running investigation into BTS agency Hybe Co. founder Bang Si-hyuk over allegations he misled investors ahead of the company’s 2020 listing.

general.title: Russians Pile $25 Billion Into Cash as War Anxiety Grows
general.summary: Russians are increasingly turning to cash as the war hits closer to home, a shift that is reversing a years-long decline in physical currency use and underscores growing anxiety about the future.

general.title: Yen Surge Puts Spotlight on BOJ and Intervention Risks | Insight with Haslinda Amin 9/3/2026
general.summary: Insight with Haslinda Amin, a daily news program featuring in-depth, high-profile interviews and analysis to give viewers the complete picture on the stories that matter. The show features prominent leaders spanning the worlds of business, finance, politics and culture. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Merz to Meet ECB Officials Before Berlin Rate Meeting Next Week
general.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz will meet European Central Bank officials next week in Berlin as they convene there for an interest-rate decision that coincides with growing speculation over President Christine Lagarde’s future.

general.title: Broadcom Forecasts Boom in AI Chip Sales
general.summary: Broadcom predicted a surge in artificial intelligence chip sales over the next two years, helping renew optimism that it can challenge Nvidia’s dominance in the lucrative market. The company also is on track to top earnings of $30 a share in fiscal 2028, outpacing Wall Street estimates. Bloomberg Intelligence analyst Matt Bloxham has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: NGN/USD:  Naira Set for Strongest Annual Gain Since 2018 Despite Elections
general.summary: Nigeria’s currency is headed for its best performance in almost a decade, as rising dollar inflows from higher oil prices and remittances help insulate the naira from political risks usually associated with its election season, according to analysts.

general.title: Waymo and Zoox expand into more U.S. markets as robotaxi race heats up
general.summary: Waymo is bringing driverless rides to three more cities, and Amazon plans to start testing in two additional U.S. markets.

general.title: Asia’s Economies Avert Energy Shock Via Fiscal Buffers, AI Boom
general.summary: Asia’s economies from India to Malaysia and Australia defied all worst-case scenarios to post solid growth last quarter, as governments moved quickly to secure energy supplies and tapped relatively healthy balance sheets to cushion households.

general.title: Trump to Levy More Chip Tariffs to Boost Manufacturing
general.summary: The Trump administration is weighing a fresh round of tariffs on imported semiconductors to lure more manufacturing to the US, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has said. Reporting from Semicon in Taiwan, Bloomberg's Stephen Engle says chip-supply-chain companies remain upbeat because AI chip demand is strong in the US. (Source: Bloomberg)
